subject: Teamwork
content: Group projects are when students work together to complete a task. Each person does a part. Some may draw, some may write, some may present. Good teamwork means sharing ideas, listening to others, doing your fair share, and helping teammates who struggle. If you have a problem, talk about it calmly. Say 'I think we should try this' instead of 'You're wrong.' Group projects teach you to cooperate and combine everyone's strengths. The best projects come from teams who work together well.
summary: Group projects: everyone does a part. Share ideas, listen, do your share, help others. Talk calmly about problems. Combine everyone's strengths.
learning_objectives: Learn to cooperate and share tasks
nigerian_examples: Working on a poster about Nigerian states together
Creating a group presentation about Nigerian festivals
Building a model of a Nigerian landmark as a team

quiz_questions.question: What should you do in a group project?
options: Let others do all the work
Do your fair share and help teammates
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Do your fair share and help teammates
quiz_questions.explanation: Everyone in a group should contribute and support each other.

quiz_questions.question: How should you talk about problems in a group?
options: Say 'I think we should try this' calmly
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Say 'I think we should try this' calmly
quiz_questions.explanation: Calm, respectful communication helps solve problems without hurting feelings.

quiz_questions.question: What happens when a team works together well?
quiz_questions.explanation: Good teamwork combines everyone's best ideas and skills.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do if a teammate is struggling?
options: Do their work without telling them
quiz_questions.explanation: Helping struggling teammates makes the whole group stronger.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: In a group project, only the leader should share ideas.
quiz_questions.explanation: Everyone in the group should share their ideas.

subject: Teamwork
content: Supporting teammates means helping them and encouraging them. When a teammate makes a mistake, say 'It's okay. Try again.' When a teammate is stuck, offer help. When a teammate feels sad, listen and comfort them. A good teammate celebrates others' successes and does not get jealous. Supporting your teammates builds strong friendships and trust. Teams that support each other do better than teams where people are mean or ignore each other. Be the teammate who lifts others up.
summary: Support teammates: say 'It's okay, try again.' Offer help. Listen when sad. Celebrate successes. Don't be jealous. Support builds trust.
nigerian_examples: Saying 'You'll get it next time' when a teammate misses a goal
Helping a teammate who doesn't understand the game rules
Celebrating when your team scores, even if you didn't score

quiz_questions.question: What should you say when a teammate makes a mistake?
quiz_questions.explanation: Encouraging words help teammates keep trying after mistakes.

quiz_questions.question: How should you react when a teammate succeeds?
quiz_questions.explanation: Celebrating teammates' successes builds team spirit.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do if a teammate is sad?
quiz_questions.explanation: Showing care and listening helps sad teammates feel better.

quiz_questions.question: What happens when teammates support each other?
options: They build trust and do better
quiz_questions.correct_answer: They build trust and do better
quiz_questions.explanation: Supportive teams are stronger and more successful.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: You should only support teammates who are your best friends.
quiz_questions.explanation: Support all your teammates, not just your closest friends.

subject: Teamwork
content: In a team, everyone's ideas matter. Sharing your ideas helps the team find better solutions. When sharing an idea, say 'I think we could try...' or 'What if we...?' Listen to others' ideas with an open mind. You can build on someone's idea by saying 'I like that, and we could also...' If you disagree, say 'I see it differently because...' Never laugh at someone's idea. The best teams listen to all ideas and combine the best parts. Your idea might be the one that solves the problem!
summary: Share ideas politely: 'I think we could try...' Listen to others. Build on ideas. Disagree respectfully. Never laugh at ideas. Your idea matters.
nigerian_examples: Sharing ideas for a class project about Nigerian food
Suggesting a new game to play during break
Offering ideas for Children's Day celebration

quiz_questions.question: How can you start sharing an idea politely?
quiz_questions.explanation: Starting with 'I think' or 'What if' shares your idea without dismissing others.

quiz_questions.question: How can you build on someone else's idea?
options: Say 'I like that, and we could also...'
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Say 'I like that, and we could also...'
quiz_questions.explanation: Building on ideas shows respect and improves the original idea.

quiz_questions.question: How should you respond to an idea you disagree with?
quiz_questions.explanation: Respectful disagreement keeps the discussion productive.

quiz_questions.question: Why should you never laugh at someone's idea?
options: It hurts feelings and stops others from sharing
quiz_questions.correct_answer: It hurts feelings and stops others from sharing
quiz_questions.explanation: Laughing at ideas makes people afraid to share in the future.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Only the smartest person in the team should share ideas.
quiz_questions.explanation: Everyone in the team has valuable ideas to share.

subject: Teamwork
content: Cooperating in games means working together toward a common goal. In team games like football, pass the ball to others instead of keeping it yourself. In relay races, cheer for your teammates. In board games, take turns and play fairly. Cooperating means you care about the team's success, not just your own. When everyone cooperates, games are more fun for everyone. Even if you lose, you can be proud that you worked well as a team. Good cooperation makes winning better and losing easier to handle.
summary: Cooperate in games: pass the ball, cheer for teammates, take turns, play fairly. Care about team success. Cooperation makes games more fun for everyone.
nigerian_examples: Passing the football to an open teammate
Cheering for your relay team members
Taking turns in a board game at home

quiz_questions.question: What does cooperating in games mean?
options: Working together toward a common goal
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Working together toward a common goal
quiz_questions.explanation: Cooperation means everyone on the team helps each other.

quiz_questions.question: In football, what is a cooperative action?
quiz_questions.explanation: Passing shares the opportunity and makes the team stronger.

quiz_questions.question: How should you treat teammates in a relay race?
quiz_questions.explanation: Cheering encourages teammates to do their best.

quiz_questions.question: What happens when everyone cooperates in games?
options: Games are more fun for everyone
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Games are more fun for everyone
quiz_questions.explanation: Cooperation makes games enjoyable for all players.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Winning is the only thing that matters in games.
quiz_questions.explanation: Having fun, learning, and cooperating are just as important as winning.

subject: Teamwork
content: Celebrating together means sharing joy when the team succeeds. When your team wins, congratulate everyone. Say 'Great job, everyone!' High-five your teammates. Acknowledge each person's contribution: 'Thanks for that great pass!' 'You defended really well!' When you celebrate as a team, everyone feels valued. Even when you don't win, you can celebrate trying hard and improving. Teams that celebrate together want to keep playing and working together. Celebrating builds team spirit and makes everyone want to do their best next time.
summary: Celebrate team success: congratulate everyone, high-five, acknowledge contributions. Celebrating builds team spirit and makes everyone feel valued.
nigerian_examples: High-fiving teammates after winning a football match
Saying 'Well done everyone' after a class presentation
Celebrating together at the end of sports day

quiz_questions.question: What should you do when your team wins?
quiz_questions.explanation: Team wins belong to everyone on the team.

quiz_questions.question: How can you celebrate a teammate's contribution?
quiz_questions.explanation: Acknowledging specific contributions shows you noticed and appreciated their effort.

quiz_questions.question: Should you celebrate only when you win?
options: No, celebrate trying hard and improving too
quiz_questions.correct_answer: No, celebrate trying hard and improving too
quiz_questions.explanation: Effort and improvement are also worth celebrating.

quiz_questions.question: What does celebrating together build?
quiz_questions.explanation: Celebrating together makes teams want to keep working together.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Celebrating should only include the players who scored or did the most.
quiz_questions.explanation: Celebrate everyone on the team, even those who played smaller roles.
